state.seed_assertion: The 24 VDC supply should be monitored near the affected load, not only at the power supply terminals, to investigate power and grounding issues.

sentences.1: The 24 VDC supply should be monitored near the affected load, not only at the power supply terminals, to investigate power and grounding issues.
sentences.2: Monitor the 24 VDC supply near the affected load, not only at the power supply terminals.
sentences.3: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.4: Continuity checks are useful for wiring verification but only with the circuit de-energised.
sentences.5: Trying to run a continuity test on a live 24 VDC circuit will give you a beep regardless of the fault because the meter's test current is swamped by the supply.
sentences.6: Using continuity mode on a live circuit produces false positive 'good' results due to the supply voltage overwhelming the meter's test current.
sentences.7: Using continuity mode on a live circuit and getting a false 'good' result from the supply voltage.
sentences.8: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
